description: Summary figures: human PDZome alphaB1 census, specificity-position comparison, and P-2 pocket geometry from the superposition
code:
import os, requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
print("cwd:",os.getcwd()); print(os.listdir(".")[:20])

census = {'H':131,'L':17,'R':16,'Y':12,'N':11,'F':11,'Q':9,'S':7,'C':5,'K':5,'P':5,'V':5,
          'M':4,'E':4,'I':2,'D':2,'W':2,'A':1,'T':1}
tot=sum(census.values())
aas=list(census.keys()); vals=[100*census[a]/tot for a in aas]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.2),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.15,1]})
ax=axes[0]
cols=['#2a6f97' if a=='H' else '#8b2f5f' if a=='Y' else '#bbbbbb' for a in aas]
ax.bar(range(len(aas)),vals,color=cols)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(aas))); ax.set_xticklabels(aas)
ax.set_ylabel("% of human PDZ domains"); ax.set_xlabel("residue at the alphaB1 specificity position")
ax.set_title("alphaB1 census, 250 human PDZ domains\n(aligned to PSD-95 PDZ3 His372)",fontsize=11,loc="left")
ax.annotate("His = class I signature\n131/250 (52.4%)",xy=(0,52.4),xytext=(2.0,46),fontsize=9,color='#2a6f97',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color='#2a6f97'))
ax.annotate("Tyr, 12/250 (4.8%)\nincludes nNOS (class III),\nARHGAP21, ARHGAP23",xy=(3,4.8),xytext=(6.0,20),fontsize=9,color='#8b2f5f',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color='#8b2f5f'))
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)

ax=axes[1]
panel=[("PSD95 PDZ3","I","H372","L323/F325","I327"),("PSD95 PDZ1","I","H130","L75/F77","I79"),
       ("NHERF1 PDZ1","I","H72","Y24/F26","L28"),("SHANK1 PDZ","I","H735","F674/F676","L678"),
       ("MAST2 PDZ","I","H1170","Y1114/F1116","L1118"),("MAST1 PDZ","I","H1033","Y977/F979","L981"),
       ("PICK1 PDZ","II","K83","L32/I35","I37"),("GRIP1 PDZ6","II","L733","L683/I685","I687"),
       ("nNOS PDZ","III","Y77","L28/F30","V32"),
       ("ARHGAP21 PDZ","?","Y137","F60/F62","L64"),("ARHGAP23 PDZ","?","Y133","F54/F56","L58")]
cm={"I":"#2a6f97","II":"#b5651d","III":"#8b2f5f","?":"#333333"}
ax.text(0.0,1.0,"PDZ domain",fontsize=9,fontweight='bold')
ax.text(0.40,1.0,"class",fontsize=9,fontweight='bold')
ax.text(0.54,1.0,"alphaB1",fontsize=9,fontweight='bold')
ax.text(0.73,1.0,"GPhiGPhi Phi",fontsize=9,fontweight='bold')
for i,(n,c,ab,gl,bb) in enumerate(panel):
    y=-i*0.95
    w = 'bold' if 'ARHGAP' in n else 'normal'
    ax.text(0.0,y,n,fontsize=9.5,fontweight=w)
    ax.text(0.40,y,c,fontsize=9.5,color=cm[c],fontweight='bold')
    ax.text(0.54,y,ab,fontsize=9.5,family='monospace',
            color='white',bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.2",fc=cm[c] if c!="?" else "#8b2f5f",ec='none'))
    ax.text(0.73,y,gl,fontsize=9.5,family='monospace')
ax.set_xlim(-0.03,1.0); ax.set_ylim(-len(panel)*0.95,1.5); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title("ARHGAP21/23 keep an intact GPhiGPhi loop but carry Tyr,\nnot His, at the class-determining alphaB1 position",fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---- P-2 pocket geometry figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.6,4.6))
lab=["PSD-95 PDZ3\nHis372 NE2","ARHGAP23 model\nTyr133 OH","PSD-95 PDZ3\nAla376 CB","ARHGAP23 model\nIle137 CG1"]
d=[2.59,2.70,4.46,4.08]
c=['#2a6f97','#8b2f5f','#9ecae1','#d9a3bd']
b=ax.bar(range(4),d,color=c)
ax.axhline(3.5,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(3.45,3.56,"upper limit for a hydrogen bond",fontsize=8,ha='right')
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_ylabel("distance to the P-2 Thr O-gamma1 (A)")
ax.set_title("The ARHGAP23 alphaB1 Tyr hydroxyl reaches the P-2 hydroxyl\nas closely as the PSD-95 class I His does",fontsize=11,loc='left')
for r,v in zip(b,d): ax.text(r.get_x()+r.get_width()/2,v+0.06,f"{v:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False); ax.set_ylim(0,5.4)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
